description: Read live in-house SocialWTF content across five sections: 'posts' (social feed from self, mutual friends, and Official Communications), 'community' (forum discussions and wiki articles), 'products' (creator storefront digital goods and music stems from self and friends), 'publications' (official platform announcements and roadmap releases), or 'trust' (Trust Center security architecture). Sections 'publications' and 'trust' require no account; 'posts', 'community', and 'products' require a registered local identity. Unlike socialwtf_sentinel_chat (which asks the Sentinel AI assistant to reason over platform data), this fetches raw structured platform records directly.

author.description: Optional author/creator filter when section is 'posts' (e.g. 'official' or an accountId) or 'products' (creator accountId).

section.description: Which platform section to read: 'posts' (social feed), 'community' (discussions & wiki), 'products' (storefront catalog), 'publications' (official announcements), or 'trust' (Trust Center security facts).

name: socialwtf_read_feed
title: Read SocialWTF Feed, Community, Products, or Roadmap
